subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to London on August 15th, 2022. Your itinerary details and e-ticket are attached to this email for your reference. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours prior to departure. Should you have any questions or require assistance, feel free to contact our customer support team. Safe travels! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
